source: Old Reference Material/Legacy Demo Catalog/Physics Demo Library (Google Docs HTML export)
note: Descriptions in the export are reference only (owner ruling 2026-09-28). image6 and image19 were replaced by the owner on 2026-09-28 before ingest. Every image was viewed before mapping; any image showing a person, a part of a person, or a reflection of one is held, never cropped. Alt text is a draft for owner review on the Part C PR. A held entry may carry draft targets (slug and alt) so the owner can release it without rewriting.

targets.alt: A thick, worn paperback catalog lying on a concrete floor beside an empty clear plastic bin labeled Interlaced Books (Friction Demo).
A black four-wheeled cart with an upright black launch tube and a steel ball resting on its deck, a loose gray cord tied to one end, beside a clear bin labeled Ballistic Cart Demo.
A floor-standing aluminum frame with five steel balls hanging in a row, each suspended by two strings from the top rails.

A ballistic pendulum stand with a spring-loaded short-range projectile launcher at its base and a swinging arm over a degree scale, with a bag of yellow and steel balls and an instruction manual on a black bench.
A yellow plush duck tangled in a long length of tan string with a metal carabiner, lying on a black bench beside a blue and orange foam-dart blaster.
A black metal track with a green cart on it, laid on a concrete floor, beside a four-wheeled aluminum cart carrying a foil-wrapped block labeled 416.6g.
A long wooden plank lying on a concrete floor with a smaller rectangular wooden block beside it and a thin wire running from the block.
A long clear plastic tube with metal end caps and a valve with a yellow handle, lying on a black bench with a small white ball and a feather inside.
A cardboard ring hand-marked with angles in degrees and radians, including 0, 90 degrees and pi over 2, and 180 degrees and pi, around a scratched metal disk with a short rod standing at its center.
Two sets of three-axis coordinate arrows on a speckled floor, one with yellow, red, and blue dowels meeting at a round wooden hub and the other with plain wooden arrows set into a dark wooden block.
A white ring with a gap standing on a clear plastic sheet marked with three numbered arrows leaving the gap, with a blue ball tied to a thread and a small orange marble inside the ring.
A blue tennis racket lying on a gray floor, with a small red LED in a black taped package fixed at the throat just below the strings.
A steel hoop, a black hoop, and two solid wooden disks, one marked M2, standing on edge at the foot of a wide wooden ramp beside a clear bin labeled Moment of Inertia Rolling Wheels.
Toys set out on a large storage bin labeled Physics Toys: a metal coiled spring toy, a wooden spinning top on a wooden launcher frame, a boxed Euler's Disk, and a box of UV-sensitive beads.
A tall ring stand with a horizontal crossbar from which four light blue balls hang on strings of different lengths.

A heavy rotating stool with a wooden seat, curved metal hand rails, and a pedestal base on a wheeled dolly, holding a pair of blue dumbbells, a coil of cord, and a weighted spoked wheel with a handle at its hub.
A clamp-on hand-crank drive with two crossed flexible brass bands forming a sphere on its spindle, lying on a concrete floor.
A black and yellow foam football patched with gray duct tape and a red tab, beside an empty clear bin labeled Doppler Football and its white lid.
A tall ring stand with a small motor and wheel on its crossbar, a small blue and white mass hanging on a line below it, and a bench power supply with a red lead running up to the motor.
Three drinking glasses on a black bench, a tall tumbler and two stemmed glasses, each filled with water to a different level.
Two cardboard tubes with blue plastic ends, joined by a string threaded through the center of each end, with spare string wound around one tube.
A clear bin with purple latches, hand-labeled Standing Waves, holding a sine wave generator with its instruction manual, a power cord, a bagged vibrator unit, a white box, and coiled yellow string.

Shelves of music demonstration equipment, including a metronome, glasses, a bottle, a cardboard tube wound with string, a tin can, a black box of knobs, a small solar panel, and lidded bins, with a handwritten sign reading Physics of Music (2 shelves), Do not separate.
A box of wire mesh set upright on a concrete floor over a small black portable radio with its antenna extended.
A long wooden board lying on a speckled floor beside an aluminum can, a piece of white fur, a white plastic rod, and a thick glass lens resting on a bin labeled Induced Dipole (+ Long Wooden Board).
The end of a white plastic rod close to an aluminum can lying on its side on a speckled floor.
A long wooden board balanced across the top of a thick glass lens on a speckled floor.
The end of a white plastic rod close to the end of a long wooden board, both lying on a speckled floor.
A metal cart holding an upright copper coil on a wooden base with a tall rod in a white sleeve, a switch box and power cord, and a spread of aluminum and copper rings, washers, and short tubes.
A copper pipe and a white plastic pipe of similar length clamped upright to a ring stand on a speckled floor.
A blue U-shaped magnet with two pole blocks on a black bench beside several metal disks on swing arms, one copper, one slotted like a comb, and a large aluminum disk on a rod.
A copper wire coil wound around a bar magnet painted half blue and half red, mounted on a clear acrylic stand with a red and a black terminal post.
Two stands, each holding a pair of long, thin parallel wires hanging from a clear acrylic bar on metal posts, with yellow leads at the top connections.
A handheld electrical wand with a pointed metal tip and a power cord, lying beside a circular fluorescent tube on a black bench.
A Tesla coil with a copper-wound secondary inside a spiral of copper tubing and a curved copper discharge arm, on a cart beside a blue transformer and a gray capacitor can.
A large gray capacitor can with a black lid carrying terminal posts and a lever, on a cart beside a blue transformer and a copper coil apparatus.
A glass-sided electroscope box with a metal ball on a rod through the top and thin metal leaves hanging inside.
A glass cathode ray tube in a yellow and black mount, wired with colored leads to a power supply box, beside an empty clear bin labeled Cathode Ray Tube.
A hand-cranked generator with a large toothed wheel on a wooden base, wired to a clear light bulb in a porcelain socket on a separate wooden board.
A clear plastic hand-crank generator with a red and a brown lead on a black bench.
A brass plug and a brass ring, each on a long rod with a wooden handle, lying on a concrete floor in front of a bin labeled Thermal Expansion Demo.
A clear plastic bag full of multicolored eight-sided dice on a white table.
A green module with a foam block and pin on top, a pen-shaped pointer clamped upright in a black stand, and a gold tin of colored pins, beside a bin labeled Poisson spot demo.
Four closed black mirror domes with openings at the top, one showing a small red object and another a small dark object, on a wooden bench beside a pencil.
Four small packets wrapped in foam and plastic with yellow warning labels, lying on a dark bench.
Two heavy horseshoe-style magnets with pole pieces facing across a gap, one black with a paper label and one gray, on a black bench.
Two tall aluminum can capacitors standing on a black bench, with terminal posts on their black tops.
A glass jar with a black lid holding a layer of fine metal filings, beside an empty clear plastic container.
Two large demonstration meters on red bases, a 0 to 10 volt voltmeter and a 0 to 30 mA milliammeter, with two smaller panel meters between them.
Two large loops of black cable wound with red wire, lying on a black bench.
